title: Has Close Elements
description: Write a function that checks whether any two numbers in a given list of floats are closer to each other than a given threshold.

clarification_questions.question: Should the function compare each element with every other element (not just adjacent ones)?
clarification_questions.explanation: The function checks ALL pairs, not just consecutive elements in the list.

clarification_questions.question: Should the comparison be strictly less than the threshold (exclusive), not less than or equal?
clarification_questions.explanation: Two elements are 'close' if their absolute difference is strictly less than the threshold.

title: String Sequence
description: Write a function that returns a string containing space-delimited numbers starting from 0 up to and including n.

clarification_questions.question: Should the output include the number n itself (inclusive)?
clarification_questions.explanation: The sequence goes from 0 to n inclusive.

clarification_questions.question: Should the numbers be separated by exactly one space with no trailing space?
clarification_questions.explanation: Standard space-delimited format with no extra whitespace.

title: Concatenate Strings
description: Write a function that concatenates a list of strings into a single string.

clarification_questions.question: Should the strings be concatenated directly without any separator between them?
clarification_questions.explanation: Direct concatenation, no delimiter added between strings.

clarification_questions.question: Should the function return an empty string when given an empty list?
clarification_questions.explanation: Empty list input should produce empty string output.

title: All Prefixes
description: Write a function that returns a list of all prefixes of the input string, from shortest to longest.

clarification_questions.question: Should the prefixes be ordered from shortest to longest?
clarification_questions.explanation: Prefixes are returned in increasing length order.

clarification_questions.question: Should the empty string be included as a prefix?
clarification_questions.explanation: The empty string is NOT included; the shortest prefix has length 1.

title: Pairs Sum to Zero
description: Write a function that determines whether there exist two distinct elements in the list that sum to zero.

clarification_questions.question: Must the two elements be at different positions in the list (i.e., can't use the same element twice)?
clarification_questions.explanation: The two elements must be at distinct indices.

clarification_questions.question: If the list contains [0, 0], should the function return True?
clarification_questions.explanation: Two zeros at different positions sum to zero, so yes.

title: Same Chars
description: Write a function that checks whether two words have the same set of characters.

clarification_questions.question: Should the comparison only consider the unique set of characters (ignoring frequency)?
clarification_questions.explanation: Only the unique characters matter, not how many times each appears.

clarification_questions.question: Should the comparison be case-sensitive?
clarification_questions.explanation: 'A' and 'a' are treated as different characters.

title: Common Elements
description: Write a function that returns sorted unique common elements for two lists.

clarification_questions.question: Should the result contain only unique elements (no duplicates even if both lists have duplicates)?
clarification_questions.explanation: The result is the sorted intersection of unique elements.

clarification_questions.question: Should the result be sorted in ascending order?
clarification_questions.explanation: The output list must be sorted in ascending order.

title: Derivative of Polynomial
description: Write a function that takes a list of coefficients representing a polynomial (xs[0] + xs[1]*x + xs[2]*x^2 + ...) and returns the derivative as a list of coefficients.

clarification_questions.question: Should the constant term (xs[0]) be dropped from the result since its derivative is 0?
clarification_questions.explanation: The derivative of a constant is 0, so the result starts from the coefficient of x.

clarification_questions.question: If the input polynomial has only a constant term, should the function return an empty list?
clarification_questions.explanation: The derivative of a constant polynomial is 0, represented as an empty list.

title: Similar Elements
description: Write a function to find the common elements from the given two tuple lists.

clarification_questions.question: Should the result be returned as a sorted tuple/list?
clarification_questions.explanation: The common elements should be returned in sorted order.

clarification_questions.question: Should duplicate elements in the input be treated as a single element?
clarification_questions.explanation: We only care about the unique intersection.

title: Square Elements
description: Write a function to find squares of individual elements in a list.

clarification_questions.question: Should the function preserve the original order of elements?
clarification_questions.explanation: The squared values should be in the same order as the input.

clarification_questions.question: Should negative numbers also be squared (resulting in positive values)?
clarification_questions.explanation: All elements are squared regardless of sign.

title: Remove Occurrence
description: Write a function to remove the first and last occurrence of a given character from a string.

clarification_questions.question: If the character appears only once, should that single occurrence be removed?
clarification_questions.explanation: When there's only one occurrence, it is both the first and last, so it gets removed.

clarification_questions.question: Should the function be case-sensitive when matching the character?
clarification_questions.explanation: Character matching is case-sensitive: 'P' and 'p' are different.

title: Check Substring
description: Write a function to check if a substring is present in a given list of string values.

clarification_questions.question: Should the function return True if the substring is found in ANY string in the list (not all)?
clarification_questions.explanation: Only one string needs to contain the substring for the result to be True.

clarification_questions.question: Should the substring matching be case-sensitive?
clarification_questions.explanation: Default string matching in Python is case-sensitive.

title: Smallest Number in List
description: Write a function to find the smallest number in a list.

clarification_questions.question: Should the function return the smallest value (not the index of the smallest value)?
clarification_questions.explanation: The function returns the minimum value itself.

clarification_questions.question: Can we assume the list is non-empty?
clarification_questions.explanation: The function is expected to receive at least one element.

title: Count Uppercase Characters
description: Write a function to count the number of uppercase characters in a string.

clarification_questions.question: Should only ASCII uppercase letters (A-Z) be counted, not digits or special characters?
clarification_questions.explanation: Only alphabetic uppercase characters are counted.

clarification_questions.question: Should the function return 0 for an empty string?
clarification_questions.explanation: An empty string has no uppercase characters.

title: Search Literal in String
description: Write a function to search for a literal string within another string and return the start position of the first match.

clarification_questions.question: Should the function return the 0-based index of the first occurrence?
clarification_questions.explanation: Python uses 0-based indexing for string positions.

clarification_questions.question: Should the function return -1 if the pattern is not found?
clarification_questions.explanation: Returning -1 is the standard convention for 'not found'.
